author: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) at the user's request; Codex steps 1 and 1.5 are unchanged inputs

no_switch_reference.requirement: R0 must reproduce events, samples, final_state and outcome exactly; otherwise stop

question: Can a numeric estimator, from observations available before the terminal phase, give MissionOS a capability estimate with a bounded uncertainty, latency and consequence previews, such that adopting the estimate after deorbit cutoff is a valid return procedure under the frozen 20% thrust loss?
pre_decision_controller: available_capacity_return_v1 with a nominal (factor 1.0) model vehicle, identical to the step-1.5 assumed-100% cells

capability_switch.allowed_phase: ballistic_return with retained-return status active (after deorbit cutoff, before the terminal trigger)
capability_switch.earliest_time: first control step at or after deorbit cutoff + burn_data_window_after_cutoff_s
capability_switch.effect: replace only the controller's model-vehicle landing-engine limits once; plant, guidance source, thresholds and contact limits unchanged
capability_switch.value_source: numeric estimator point estimate named by estimate_id; never a number written by a model

sensor_model.engine_telemetry: per-engine availability and throttle state; no thrust or chamber pressure
sensor_model.mass_source: nominal vehicle model with existing fuel gauge
sensor_model.basis: engineering test settings, not Starship sensor specifications

estimator_definition: Per accepted sample: (measured body-z specific force minus nominal force of non-landing engines from their throttle states) / (nominal landing-engine force from throttle states / gauge-model mass). Estimate = mean. Half-width = 3*std/sqrt(n) + 3*bias_sigma/mean expected acceleration + estimate*gauge_bound/mass + model_allowance. Anomaly when n >= minimum_samples and |estimate - 1| > half-width.

calibration.rng: numpy default_rng([20261014, factor_index, seed]); bias drawn once per seed, then per-sample noise
calibration.actual_80_source: R0 prefix (identical pre-switch controller and plant)
calibration.pass_rule: for 0.8 and 0.6: every seed detects before the burn-complete request and both detection and complete bands contain the true factor; for 1.0: no seed ever flags an anomaly and the complete band contains 1.0

request.request_1: issued at the first control step where the anomaly rule holds; burn data incomplete; allowed: continue, collect_status, adopt; no previews
request.request_2: issued at the burn-complete time; allowed: continue, adopt; previews for adopt and continue at band low, point estimate and band high, using estimated (not known) plant capability from a deep-copied state/controller snapshot
request.fixture_decision: deterministic transport fixture only; not AI evidence

runs.purpose: faithfulness to step 1.5 and actual-80% telemetry

runs.kind: 6 prediction branches from the R0 snapshot

runs.purpose: snapshot continuation must equal R0 final state and outcome exactly
late-switch validity, tolerance and timing invariance

tolerance.meaning: known-capability evaluation only; never shown in a request

result_actions_ordered.label: incomplete_stop
result_actions_ordered.when: budget, input/source change, numerical error, invalid record, failure to reproduce R0 reference or inexact snapshot continuation
result_actions_ordered.next: retain records, report incomplete and stop; no physical conclusion

result_actions_ordered.label: estimator_not_ready
result_actions_ordered.next: report coverage or false-alarm failure; do not widen bands or retune after results; step 3 cannot use this estimator

result_actions_ordered.label: post_cutoff_switch_not_valid
result_actions_ordered.when: R4 assumed 0.80 at delay 0 misses any contact limit
result_actions_ordered.next: report; step 3 cannot use post-cutoff capability adoption; any earlier switch needs a new registration

result_actions_ordered.label: estimate_band_exceeds_adopt_tolerance
result_actions_ordered.when: an adopt preview at a band point misses a limit
result_actions_ordered.next: report genuine uncertainty that the request must show; step 3 registration must decide how MissionOS handles it

result_actions_ordered.label: ready_for_step3_registration
result_actions_ordered.next: report and stop; step 3 (live MissionOS decision, independent check, execution) needs a separate registration and user approval

comparison_rule: no comparison with scenario-encoded Rules scores; the step-4 comparator remains the original plan under the identical fault
stop: always report and stop before step 3
